data.bio: Xavier is the middle child in a large family of seven siblings, which has taught him the value of sharing, cooperation, and finding his own voice in a crowded household. Growing up with six siblings - Ben, Fil, Fannie, Doris, Laura, and Boris - Xavier developed strong relationships with each of them while also learning to be independent. He works as a project manager for a technology company, where he uses his natural leadership skills and ability to coordinate multiple tasks simultaneously. Xavier enjoys playing basketball, reading science fiction novels, and organizing family gatherings. He maintains close relationships with his parents Sandy and Casey, and appreciates the unique family dynamic that comes from having so many siblings.

She enjoys cooking large family meals, reading, and spending time with her children. Sandy comes from a close-knit family and maintains strong relationships with her parents Andy and Sally Anne.
